about: Made-up rows. No Splunk produced these: fake_splunk.py serves them as the results of proxy_domain_lookup's search (ace3's etc/saq.splunk_modules.yaml) for the hostname the search quotes. Names are under example.com and addresses are in the documentation ranges 192.0.2.0/24 and 198.51.100.0/24. Each row has only the fields the module's result handling reads: _time, for the event time, and the five fields its observable_mapping names. The third row leaves out src_translated_ip and user, as a real row with no NAT and no authenticated user would.
